title: Isolated admin build generates pages but shell exit needs confirmation
summary: Local release compiled and generated all 249 pages, but PowerShell returned exit 1 after a stderr warning. Capture the child exit code directly before declaring build validation successful.

changes.detail: Add direct child-process output and exit-code capture to distinguish build failures from PowerShell native stderr warnings.

validation.name: TypeScript and focused runtime tests
validation.detail: Isolated release TypeScript passed; all 23 focused tests passed.

validation.name: First local build shell result
validation.detail: Shell returned exit 1. Log shows successful compile and 249/249 static pages with a workspace-root inference warning, and a generated BUILD_ID. Native child exit status was not separately recorded, so full build success is not asserted.

validation.name: Remote deployment approval
validation.detail: Automatic approval review rejected uploading private application source and creating a Vercel production candidate, even with --skip-domain. No remote build, promotion or live domain change performed.
